# WEDthread

> WEDthread is a wedding planning platform for couples. It brings the guest list, RSVPs, seating chart, budget, registry and wedding website into one plan, and includes a directory of wedding venues and vendors. It is built for weddings of every size, culture and style, including destination weddings and weddings with several events.

## Planning tools

- [Wedding guest list manager](https://www.wedthread.co/features/guest-list): per-event invitations, RSVP tracking, dietary needs and WhatsApp or email messages
- [Wedding budget planner](https://www.wedthread.co/features/budgeting): categories, events, charts, expense tracking and payment reminders
- [Wedding seating chart maker](https://www.wedthread.co/features/seating): drag and drop tables with capacity and allergy warnings
- [Online wedding RSVP](https://www.wedthread.co/features/rsvp-automation): personal RSVP links sent by WhatsApp or email
- [Wedding registry](https://www.wedthread.co/features/registry): gifts from any store and cash funds
- [Wedding website builder](https://www.wedthread.co/features/website): templates with schedule, travel details, registry and RSVP

## Directories

- [Wedding venues](https://www.wedthread.co/venue): browse by city, capacity, price and type of space
- [Wedding vendors](https://www.wedthread.co/v): photographers, planners, caterers, florists and more

- [Top 10 things to sort for your wedding, in order of priority](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/wedding-planning-priorities): what to book and decide first
- [Wedding budget planning, step by step](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/wedding-budget-planning): splitting the budget and planning for weather, delays and changes
- [Unique wedding ideas for 2026 and 2027](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/unique-wedding-ideas): live painting, a LEGO table, a photo booth, a quiz night and more
- [Wedding planning timeline: 12 months to 1 week out](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/wedding-planning-timeline): a month-by-month checklist
- [How to plan a multi-event wedding](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/plan-a-multi-event-wedding): separate guest lists, venues, dress codes and budgets per event
- [How to build your wedding guest list](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/wedding-guest-list): A-list and B-list, plus-ones, children and who to leave off
- [Wedding RSVPs: when to send, how to chase, what to ask](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/wedding-rsvps): deadlines, dietary needs and per-event replies
- [How to do a wedding seating plan](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/wedding-seating-plan): family dynamics, table shapes and dropouts
- [20 questions to ask a wedding venue](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/questions-to-ask-a-wedding-venue): capacity, curfew, vendors, deposits and weather backup
- [Planning a two-culture wedding](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/two-culture-wedding): blending traditions both families will love
- [Destination wedding planning](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/destination-wedding-planning): legal paperwork, guest travel and choosing the country
- [Wedding planning app vs spreadsheet vs planner](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/wedding-planning-app-vs-spreadsheet-vs-planner): an honest comparison
- [Wedding costs couples forget to budget for](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/hidden-wedding-costs): service charges, tips, alterations, overtime and more
- [Who pays for what at a wedding](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/who-pays-for-what-at-a-wedding): splitting costs with families and keeping a record
- [How to choose a wedding photographer](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/how-to-choose-a-wedding-photographer): galleries, questions, contracts and a shot list
- [Wedding planner or day-of coordinator?](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/wedding-planner-vs-day-of-coordinator): what each does, costs and how to hire
- [Wedding catering and menu planning](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/wedding-catering-and-menu-planning): tastings, cost per guest and dietary needs
- [What to put on your wedding website](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/what-to-put-on-your-wedding-website): pages to include and when to launch
- [Mehendi, sangeet and haldi: what each event is](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/mehendi-sangeet-haldi-guide): who comes, how long, what to wear and plan
- [How to plan a small wedding](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/how-to-plan-a-small-wedding): guest list, venue and spending on what matters
- [Wedding registry etiquette](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/wedding-registry-etiquette): asking for gifts, cash or a honeymoon fund
- [Wedding day timeline: an hour-by-hour run sheet](https://www.wedthread.co/blog/wedding-day-timeline): sample run sheet and a free printable PDF
